title: bias-only correction g v2 (d/s-symmetric smooth inputs, static element via a charge-free card replica, gm/gds penalty) as a deployable ngspice-41 OSDI add-on, sky130 77 K, 18 devices
data: sky130 77 K, all 18 devices (REAL_DEV + REAL_TEST, opened by user decision 2026-10-21); starting-card records out/research/explore/E1/real_dev + real_test with direct43_r3_fd cards
done_before: charge-free replica check on the published card (nmos_L1_W1p6, pmos_L2_W5): DC equal to 12 digits, imaginary AC replica current 0
penalty grids of the 18 starting cards
penalty value of the stored v1 corrections (calib/calib_v1.json)

inputs.definition: s = +1 nMOS / -1 pMOS; a = s V(g,s); b = s V(g,d); m = sqrt(V(d,s)^2 + EPS^2); x1 = (a + b + m) / (2 VDD); x2 = m / VDD; network input (is_pmos, x1, x2) standardized with training-point mean/std, is_pmos kept 0/1

element.sense: V(sense) <+ RS * I(sense), RS = 0, branch rx -> ri
element.replica: same subcircuit and bins as the card (same bin patch), every bin: xpart=-1 cgso=0 cgdo=0 cgbo=0 cgsl=0 cgdl=0 cf=0 cjs=0 cjd=0 cjsws=0 cjswd=0 cjswgs=0 cjswgd=0; terminals driven by unit-gain VCVS copies of V(d), V(g), V(s), V(b); replica drain at ri; rx driven by the V(d) copy

penalty.grid: u_g in {0, 0.025, ..., 1.85} V x u_d in {0.025, ..., 1.85} V, u = s V (forward quadrant = measured range of every device)
penalty.card: training card of the device (direct43_r3_fd), canonical ngspice-41 /Users/anrunw/cryo-ng41/arm64/bin/ngspice, default tolerances
penalty.r: r_gm = gm_card/I_card + dg/du_g, r_gds = gds_card/I_card + dg/du_d (1/V); card derivatives by central differences on the grid (one-sided at edges); dg/du by autograd
penalty.P: mean over training devices of per-device mean of relu(-r_gm) + relu(-r_gds)
penalty.lambda_rule: smallest value of the 1-2-5-10 sequence with lambda * P(v1 full) > in-sample E1 loss of v1 full (P = 0.00873 /V, loss 0.0732 -> 8.4 -> 10)

unchanged.mlp: 3-16-16-1 tanh, zero-init last layer, OUT_SCALE 1 tanh output

refit.metric: strict paper RRMS, inclusion frozen to the published card's curve set

part_A.protocol: LODO over 18 devices; g v2 trained on the other 17 records and their penalty grids; held-out refit with the fold g in the loop; full-data g v2 on all 18 for part B
reported: fraction of training grid points with negative corrected gm / gds

part_B.card: M2: refit from direct43_r3_fd with the full-data g v2 in the loop (in-sample)

benches.forward: card (nd, ng, 0, 0), module d = nd, s = 0
benches.exchanged: card drain nz (VZ 0 V to ground), card source nd; module d = nz, s = nd

q1.equivalence: |I_elem - I_py| <= 1e-6 |I_py| + 1e-13 A at every grid point, tight, both benches

va_text.range: both polarities, V(g,s), V(d,s) uniform in [-1.85, 1.85] V

q1.swap_asym: element-introduced |ln(I_swap/I_fwd)_elem - ln(I_swap/I_fwd)_card|, forward operation, |I| > 1 nA, tight
q1.swap_asym_expected: nonzero from BSIM4 junction gmin currents (gmin 1e-12 S) in the replica drain-terminal current; bound about (1 - exp(-|g|)) * 1.85e-12 / 1e-9 <= 1e-3

q2.op_points: I11-1 (gm sets |Vds| 0.05/0.925/1.85 x |Vgs| grid; gds sets |Vgs| 0.6/0.9/1.2/1.5/1.85 x |Vds| grid)
q2.python: Re Y = exp(g) Re Y_card + I_card exp(g) dg/dV (central differences h = 1e-5 V); Im Y = Im Y_card
q2.derivative_error: |Y_elem - Y_py| / max(|Y_py|, 1e-9 S), real parts, |I_py| > 1 nA
q2.capacitance_error: |Im Y_elem - Im Y_card| / max(|Im Y_card|, 1e-15 S) for Y_dd, Y_dg, Y_gg, all op points
q2.sign_rule: I11-1 curve-level rule (strong inversion |Vgs| >= V_T + 0.2 V; gm < -1e-12 S on the element curve and none on the card-only curve; gds curves at |Vds| >= 0.05 V)

q4.statistic: median wall time ratio element / card only (grid deck, 18 devices; circuits M2_full / M2_card)

rule.changes_from_I11_1: Q1 tight relative 1e-5 replaced by the per-point criterion; exchange asymmetry and capacitance moved from restrictions to core; Verilog-A g checks added to core

V1.what: fit_v2 with abs_v1 inputs, lambda 0, v1 hyperparameters
V1.pass: max |g_new - g_stored| over the 17 training records' points <= 1e-9 on both

V2.what: held-out refit with the stored v1 fold correction

V3.pass: exactly one row per device for the 18 devices

decision.invalid: any validity check fails -> stop: fix and re-register
decision.supported: A1 and A2 pass and part B not 'not deployable' -> continue: v2 replaces v1 as the deployable add-on
decision.deployable, accuracy below v1: A1 passes, A2 fails, part B not 'not deployable' -> stop v2; report the accuracy cost
decision.not deployable: A1 passes, part B 'not deployable' -> stop; diagnose the failed core checks

prediction_commit: none (I11-1 pattern; no training-set statistic pre-registered)

other.D1_no_card_shift: held-out and M2 cards refit inside the stored base box; no clamp (I10-1 mechanism does not arise)
other.D2_replica_check: every replica bin carries every REPLICA_ZERO value; checked before each deck
other.D3_smoke: 2 folds, 1 seed, 200 steps, refit max_nfev 20; part B on 2 devices with starting cards; not used for decisions
other.D4_order: prereg commit alone -> code + unit tests -> smoke -> queue (validity, lodo, deploy, decide), one heavy job at a time

no_measured_circuit_data: part B circuits are simulator-level consistency, convergence and runtime checks
